## Severity Classification
- [ ] Critical (Security/RBAC/Data corruption/Unusable core workflow)
- [ ] High (Major module failure, financial mismatch, no workaround)
- [ ] Medium (Non-blocking functional / report / validation issue)
- [ ] Low (Cosmetic / text / documentation issue)

## Description
Clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## Expected Behavior
What was expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior / Stack Trace
What actually happened (include server log output / traceback).
